abstract: Maintains independent energy market intelligence and industry developer performance indices
system_message:
You are the Regional power market analyst (ADV), responsible for maintaining independent energy market intelligence, developer performance indices, and monitoring locational market dynamics across regional power delivery hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Locational price volatility（VOL）
information_points.content:
ADV-VOL-ND0：According to the regional transmission organization market survey over the preceding 12 months, the nodal price volatility index for Aura Bay Wind Consortium's commercial delivery pricing hub is 18 points.
ADV-VOL-7SD：Solaria Horizon Energy Group's applicable delivery hub recorded a nodal price volatility index of 34 points across day-ahead locational marginal electricity prices over the preceding 12 months.
ADV-VOL-CBR：The nodal price volatility index at the commercial delivery pricing hub for Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures is 26 points over the preceding 12 months.

information_points.title: Maintains independent energy market intelligence and industry developer performance indices（MRKT）
information_points.content:
ADV-MRKT-4KY：For Aura Bay Wind Consortium, the developer industry reputation index is evaluated at 78 points based on the lead sponsor's operating track record and standardized counterparty reliability score over the prior five years.
ADV-MRKT-Z9Z：For Solaria Horizon Energy Group, the developer industry reputation index stands at 65 points reflecting the lead sponsor's five-year operational execution record.
ADV-MRKT-5SZ：Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures holds a developer industry reputation index of 92 points according to the independent energy developer benchmark tracking five-year counterparty reliability.
